# semaphore_ex_oidc_group_mapping (Resource)

Maps an external identity-provider group to a custom role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "semaphore_ex_oidc_group_mapping" "operators" {
  id          = "operators"
  provider_id = "corporate-oidc"
  claim_value = "operators"
  enabled     = true

  target = {
    scope   = "global"
    role_id = semaphore_ex_global_role.operator.id
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `claim_value` (String) OIDC group claim value to map without leading or trailing whitespace.
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `provider_id` (String)
- `target` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--target))

### Read-Only

- `group_external_id` (String) Not applicable to OIDC mappings.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `revision` (Number)
